caption: The drawing depicts a spotted horse with a cream-colored body covered in brown spots, a light tan mane and tail, and black hooves. The horse is shown in profile facing left, with its front right leg lifted. The horse has blue decorations on its bridle and a colorful saddle blanket, which is predominantly yellow, green, and brown with a blue bird and a white flower motif. There is a single metal stirrup visible hanging from the saddle. The drawing is enclosed within a double-lined rectangular border. In the upper right corner, there is a small, simple, line-drawn sketch of a horse in the same pose, positioned within a square. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a signature with a date in the bottom right corner inside the border, reading "Samuel S. Hinson Del 1841."
title: Carousel Horse
